title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Stir-Fried Mu Shu Vegetables
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish that combines the flavors of pork chops with the crunch of stir-fried mu shu vegetables.

ingredients.name: mu shu vegetables
ingredients.notes: found in most Chinese grocery stores

ingredients.name: amazing al dente noodles
ingredients.notes: use to serve with the pork and vegetables

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: for pan-frying the pork and vegetables

ingredients.name: salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: for seasoning the pork and vegetables

instructions: Preheat a skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Season the pork chops with salt and pepper.
Add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet and sear the pork chops for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the pork chops to a plate and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the mu shu vegetables and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the amazing al dente noodles to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the pork chops to the skillet and stir-fry everything together for 1-2 minutes.
Serve the pork and vegetables over the noodles and garnish with green onions.
